specification.mechanism: Incremental atmospheric withdrawal through existing SID 312 to sink SID 316
specification.design_basis: Set both twins to the pinned nominal 0.001 m^2 before 1000 s. Increase only the intervention final area by 10%. These are design settings, not source leak ground truth or calibration. The event is on the 0.2 s grid and separated from the existing 25 s pressure step.
specification.downstream: Existing atmospheric reservoir SID 316; confirm pressure and temperature in capture.
specification.matching: Both twins receive the same variable restriction and PS Step wiring. Only final_value differs between the twins. Keep physical parameters, native controls, sensor mapping, initial-state policy, and horizon fixed.
specification.solver_basis: 0.2 s is the finest completed NORMAL resolution; no certified numerical tolerance is implied.
specification.gas: Pinned SID 4 configured constant-property perfect-gas representation; R=0.287 kJ/(kg K), Z=0.998386; composition and hydrogen fidelity unverified.
qualification: Verify both effective area command histories and timed change in the intervention.
Verify signed branch flow, upstream and downstream pressure, and atmospheric sink state.
Compare derived NORMAL with original 0.2 s NORMAL and both twins before the event.
Check after-event incremental outflow and all sensor histories before treating the label as a verified intervention.
